concept: Mediterranean villas in a green community; villa picker.

shots.title: Hero
shots.section: Home hero, full screen behind the headline
shots.camera: Eye-level three-quarter view, 24mm tilt-shift, corrected verticals
shots.prompt: Architectural photograph of white Mediterranean villas with terracotta roofs among olive trees in a green community in Dubai. Golden-hour sun rakes across the facade, verticals perfectly straight, landscaped foreground, clear sky with open space above for a headline. It must feel built and lived-in, not rendered. No people. Overall look: sunny Mediterranean photography, 35mm; colour palette of olive, white, terracotta, sky blue. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Interiors
shots.camera: Interior, 24mm, eye level, one window light
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs separated by thin white gutters, all four in one consistent style and light. Interior photographs inside white Mediterranean villas with terracotta roofs among olive trees, finished in white plaster, terracotta and oak, staged and uncluttered, one soft daylight, nobody present. Top-left: the main living room with its view. Top-right: the kitchen and dining area. Bottom-left: the principal bedroom. Bottom-right: the principal bathroom. Overall look: sunny Mediterranean photography, 35mm; colour palette of olive, white, terracotta, sky blue. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
